name: Youth Member on City Advisory Bodies (non-voting)
what_you_do: Join a city commission or committee as a youth member. You go to meetings and share a teen view. You do not vote.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18 who go to El Cerrito High School or live in El Cerrito. A parent or guardian must give written consent. You can serve until your 19th birthday or until you graduate from El Cerrito High School.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Each application on file stays valid for one year from the date received.
how_to_apply: Submit the youth application on the city page. A parent or guardian must give written consent. Applicants will be invited to interview with the City Council at a publicly noticed meeting. The City Clerk handles questions.
notes: Ten city groups want a youth member. They include the Park and Recreation Commission, the Planning Commission and the Committee on Aging. The full list is on the page. Youth members must follow attendance rules and do orientation training. They also take a one-hour harassment prevention training. City Clerk phone: 510-215-4305.
